subject.title: fix: strip volatile output from exec result hash to fix no-progress detection (#93917)

question: Should repeated failed exec calls with the same stable failure fingerprint ignore volatile output and be allowed to trip critical/global blocking thresholds?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and source-backed, but it deliberately changes when repeated failed exec attempts stop an agent, so the availability tradeoff needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
options.body: Merge after docs alignment and exact-head validation if maintainers agree stable failed exec outcomes should stop runaway sessions earlier.

options.title: Defer For Broader Loop Policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want to settle session-wide or fuzzy loop-detection semantics before changing failed-exec hashing.

recommendation.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
recommendation.body: Merge after docs alignment and exact-head validation if maintainers agree stable failed exec outcomes should stop runaway sessions earlier.
